meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把画面素材渲染成视频,并在本地或云端跑通预览与发布全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把素材或画面批量渲染成视频,并在本地或云端完成预览与发布。
copy.tagline_en: Render frames into finished videos and run preview through publish locally or in the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render frames or footage into videos in batches and preview-to-publish locally or in the cloud.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令走完整流程:初始化项目、搜索现成动效、编写合成、跑 lint 和 check 检查,再预览并渲染出视频文件,也能排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你用 HyperFrames 创建、预览或渲染视频项目,或排查构建、渲染失败时接管;涵盖本地、HeyGen 云、AWS Lambda 等渲染环境。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses npx hyperframes commands: init a project, search the catalog for moves, author the composition, run lint and check, preview, then render a video file. It also diagnoses build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you create, preview or render a HyperFrames video project, or when you need to diagnose build or render failures. Covers local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda and other render targets.

say_en.text: Init a new hyperframes project called my-video
Search the catalog for a headline reveal, one line at a time
Check my composition, then render it to out.mp4
say_en.note: check runs first, then the render
